name: Sunset Express
blurb: Pacific Sunset's domestic express airline, connecting six hubs across the continental United States, Puerto Rico and Hawaii.

about: Sunset Express is Pacific Sunset's domestic express airline and the second member of the Pacific Sunset Group.
The airline previously belonged to MalAlliance until that alliance became extinct in November 2026.
network: Sunset Express operates from Long Beach, San Juan, Dallas/Fort Worth, New York JFK, Maui and Honolulu, combining mainland flying with services across Puerto Rico and Hawaii.
